text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—This year's "Lucky Umamusume Race" is 
about to begin! As usual, many 
fleet-footed hopefuls have gathered for 
this traditional New Year's event.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we have guest participants from 
Tracen Academy joining us again this year! 
Everyone, please give them a warm round of 
applause!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahahaaaaa! Rejoice, everyone! This 
year, I have arrived-!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it! To the moment when I, 
who am already overflowing with good 
fortune, become this year's lucky horse 
girl...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooohhh! It's T.M. Opera O!! Could our 
guest actually win this year!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, guests get heavily marked every 
year, don't they? Plus, they won't be used 
to the course..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Plus, "that girl" is running this year 
too! Heard she trained like crazy with 
this race as her goal. Ooh, this is gonna 
be one hell of a show!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph! Hate to break it to you when you're 
so set on winning, but I'll be taking the 
consecutive championship again this year!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...! With that intensity, I'd say 
you're quite skilled...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A rival appears, huh... Bring it on! I 
never hold back, no matter what kind of 
race it is!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sparks fly fiercely between the two...! 
The starter pistol sounds, signaling the 
beginning of the race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful eyes of the roadside 
gallery, the one running in the lead 
was...

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And now, the front runners come into view! 
In first is last year's Lucky Umamusume! 
Can she hold them off?! TM Opera O is 
gunning for the lead!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa...! I've got you now! My worthy 
rival—!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Ow! Ouch-ouch-ouch...! My nail...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: “—Ghk! What happened to you...!?”

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... It hurts, but... I'm fine... so 
just go...! You gotta run, quickly... or 
you'll lose...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Bwahahahahaaa!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think of others even while bearing 
injuries... what a beautiful heart! 
Magnificent! You truly possess a noble 
spirit...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry. Who do you think 
I am!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! I'm leaving her in your 
hands!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand here comes T.M. Opera O moving up 
fast~~~! Plunging straight into the pack 
and breaking out in an instant~!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
A victory by a landslide...! This year's 
Lucky Umamusume is TM Opera O~~!! The 
Lucky Umamusume of the Century's End is 
born right here~~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahahaaaaa! Hear ye, everyone! This 
year's Lucky Umamusume is meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waah! Amazing! She won! I want to be able 
to run like that too!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! A natural admiration indeed! 
After witnessing such a magnificent 
comeback...!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Saving a child and still winning the 
race... It's my total defeat. I still have 
a long way to go...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You put up a splendid fight as well! A 
protagonist only shines brightest against 
a worthy rival... I hereby present you 
with the Best Supporting Actor Award!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooohhhhhh~~~~!! Congratulations! 
End-of-the-Century Lucky Umamusume~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on! Let's high-five! I'll 
share some of my good fortune with 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha! Bwahahahahahahahaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand here is T.M. Opera O! T.M. Opera O 
is coming up faaast! Side by side, they 
crrrrross the fiiiiniiiish liiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
—As expected of the fleetest feet among 
semi-pros!! She refuses to give an inch 
again this year! TM Opera O finishes in a 
heartbreaking 2nd place~~~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Kh! Just one step short...! Is this 
another trial meant for the protagonist!?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san... you were so cool! I've 
never seen such amazing running before!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe! I'm so glad I could make 
you smile! As expected of me!

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I won. After all, this year's Lucky 
Umamusume is me...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, congrats on 1st place! Your 
strength... was truly worthy of gracing my 
big stage!"

text_block_list.name: Semi-Pro Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... You really won't make 
excuses, will you? Helping that girl and 
still pulling off a chase like that... 
...It was so cool, it's actually 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course I'm cool! Looks like 
you're completely captivated by me 
already, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To captivate people even in defeat...! Ah, 
my brilliance truly knows no bounds!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"TM Opera O narrowly missed out on the 
title of 'Lucky Umamusume.' Yet, she shone 
cooler and brighter than anyone else!"
